From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Date: 2027-04-20 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [INVESTIGATING] Production latency spike — preliminary

Quick update from ops:

- Correlation: sudden spike in long-tail latencies aligns with a burst of long-context requests from one customer tokenization pattern (trace ids: 5532, 5534).
- Symptoms: KV-cache eviction thrash on GPU pool serving the Silverline model shard; memory pressure triggered model fallbacks to CPU which caused 5xx and timeouts.
- Immediate mitigation: bumped dedicated pool size + forced warm replicas for Silverline's model shard. That reduced 5xx but tail latency remains elevated for large-context (>8k tokens) calls.

Next steps (short):
1) Collect samples of offending payloads (Vivek)
2) Run a controlled repro on staging with quantized variant (Rishi)
3) Provide a permanent schedule: cache-reserve and model-quantization plan (ETA 48-72h)

I'll compile logs and a root cause summary for the customer-facing note.

-rishi
SRE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-22 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Silverline inference outage: root cause summary and corrective-plan (deliverables attached)

Asha / Raj —

Please find the attached root-cause summary and our corrective action plan (silverline_rca_20270422.pdf, silverline_commit_matrix_20270422.csv). High-level summary:

- Root cause: KV-cache allocation thrash on the inference GPU pool serving Silverline's model variant triggered by an unanticipated pattern of long-context ad-hoc requests. The thrash caused repeated model reloads and fallback to CPU inference, producing 5xx and elevated tail latency.
- Impact window: 2027-04-20 15:55 UTC to 2027-04-20 16:05 UTC (≈10 minutes). Estimated affected requests: ~12k; peak error rate ~15% for the period.

Committed corrective actions (owners / ETA):
- Reserve dedicated KV-cache slots for Silverline model shard — Owner: Rishi Malhotra — ETA: 2027-04-23 23:59 UTC — Status: In progress
- Hot-warm replica policy for known long-context endpoints — Owner: Vivek Kulkarni — ETA: 2027-04-24 12:00 UTC — Status: Done
- Deploy quantized model variant for large context paths (lower mem & faster cold-start) — Owner: Grace O'Connor — ETA: 2027-04-25 18:00 UTC — Status: Scheduled
- Post-incident performance alert tuning and pre-flight token-length checks — Owner: Prioym Das — ETA: 2027-04-26 00:00 UTC — Status: Scheduled

We propose a short exec readout tomorrow at 10:30 PT if that works for your leadership to walk through impact and credits. Also attaching logs and the commit tracker. Links: https://drive.redwood.com/s/silverline-rca-20270422 and ticket INC-4521: https://app.redwood.com/tickets/INC-4521

If you want immediate rollback options or additional mitigation (rate-limit large requests), we can implement temporary safeguards while the permanent fixes land.

Regards,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Follow-up: Silverline incident — actions update and closure steps

Asha / Raj — quick follow-up after the readout:

Status summary (2027-04-25):
- KV-cache reservation: Completed (Rishi) — verified reduction in model reloads; no repeat incidents in the pool over 48h.
- Hot-warm replica policy: Completed (Vivek) — rolling config applied to Silverline endpoints.
- Quantized variant deployment for large-context path: Completed to staging; rollout to production scheduled for 2027-04-26 02:00 UTC with canary.
- Alerts & token-length gating: Implemented (Prioym) — new pre-flight checks will block >16k token requests unless flagged; grace window policy in place for back-compat.

Attached: updated commit tracker and post-deploy perf graphs (links below). We consider this incident mitigated and moving to post-incident monitoring for 7 days.

Open items:
- Final credit computation & posting (Prioym) — ETA: 2027-04-26 17:00 UTC
- Production rollout and performance verification — ETA: 2027-04-26 06:00 UTC
